40005761.author: पदार्थः
40005761.content: विभुः the lord, पादवताम् among the bipeds, वरः best, सः that Bharata, सेनाम् army, निवेश्य after encamping, गुरुवर्तकम् devoted the preceptor (father), काकुत्थ्सम् Rama, पद्भ्याम् on foot, अभिगन्तुम् to approach, इयेष wished.

40005761.author: Translation
40005761.content: On encamping the army, lord Bharata, the best among men, wished to approach on foot Rama who was devoted to his father.

40005762.author: पदार्थः
40005762.content: सैन्ये army, यथोद्देशम् in assigned places, निविष्टमात्रे after encamping, भरतः Bharata, भ्रातरम् brother, शत्रुघ्नम् to Satrughna, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

40005762.author: Translation
40005762.content: After the army encamped in the assigned places, Bharata said to his brother Satrughna thus:

40005763.author: पदार्थः
40005763.content: सौम्य O dear Satrughna, नरसङ्घै: with groups of people, सहितैः accompanied by, लुब्धैश्च  in the company of hunters as well, त्वम् you, क्षिप्रम् quickly, इदं वनम् this forest, समन्ततः all over, अन्वेषितुम् to explore, अर्हसि should.

40005763.author: Translation
40005763.content: O dear Satrughna, you should explore this forest quickly along with groups of our people and  hunters as well.

40005764.author: पदार्थः
40005764.content: गुहः Guha, शरचापासिधारिणा armed with bows, arrows and swords, ज्ञातिसहस्रेण with a thousand kinsmen, परिवृतः surrounded by, स्वयम् himself, अस्मिन् in this forest, काकुत्स्थम् Rama, समन्वेषतु explore.

40005764.author: Translation
40005764.content: Let Guha, surrounded by a thousand kinsmen and armed with bows, arrows and swords look for Rama.

40005765.author: पदार्थः
40005765.content: स्वयम् I myself, अमात्यैः सह with counsellors, पौरैश्च with citizens, गुरुभिश्च with preceptors, द्विजातिभिः with brahmins, परिवृतः surrounded by, सर्वम् entire, वनम् forest, पद्भ्याम् on foot, चरिष्यामि I shall move about.

40005765.author: Translation
40005765.content: 'I myself shall go on foot surrounded by ministers, citizens, preceptors and brahmins and search the entire forest.

40005766.author: पदार्थः
40005766.content: रामम् Rama, महाबलम् powerful, लक्ष्मणं वा Lakshmana, महाभागां illustrious, वैदेहीं च Sita, यावत्  till such time, न द्रक्ष्यामि I do not see, मे to me, शान्ति peace, न भविष्यति shall not come.

40005766.author: Translation
40005766.content: 'I shall not rest in peace until I see Rama, powerful Lakshmana and illustrious princess of Videha (Sita).

40005767.author: पदार्थः
40005767.content: चन्द्रसङ्काशम् radiant as the Moon, पद्मपलाशाक्षम् eyes resembling lotuspetals, भ्रातुः brother Rama, शुभम् auspicious, आननम् face, यावत् till such time, न द्रक्ष्यामि I do not see, मे to me, शान्तिः peace, न भविष्यति shall not come.

40005767.author: Translation
40005767.content: I shall not attain peace until I see my brother, Rama whose auspicious countenance looks radiant as the Moon and whose eyes as lotuspetals.

40005768.author: पदार्थः
40005768.content: भ्रातुः brother's, पार्थिवव्यञ्जनान्वितौ bearing the signs of royalty, चरणौ feet, यावत् till such time, शिरसा with the head, न धारयिष्यामि I will not carry, मे to me, शान्ति: peace, न भविष्यति  shall not come.

40005768.author: Translation
40005768.content: Peace shall not come to me until I hold on my head the feet of my brother, the insignia of royalty.

40005769.author: पदार्थः
40005769.content: राज्यार्हः one who is worthy of this kingdom, अभिषेकजलक्लिन्नः wet with the holy waters of consecration, पितृपैतामहे pertaining to our father and forefathers, राज्ये in the kingdom, यावत् till such time, न स्थितः is not established, मे my, शान्तिः peace, न भविष्यति shall not attain.

40005769.author: Translation
40005769.content: I shall not attain peace until Rama, who is worthy of this kingdom, is sprinkled with the holy water of coronation and assumes the ancestral kingdom.

40005770.author: पदार्थः
40005770.content: यः who, चन्द्रविमलोपमम् like the spotless Moon, राजीवाक्षम् whose eyes resemble red lotuses, महाद्युति of great effulgence, रामस्य Rama's, मुखम् countenance, पश्यति beholds, सौमित्रिः Lakshmana, सिद्दार्थः खलु blessed indeed.

40005770.author: Translation
40005770.content: Lakshmana, one who beholds the highly effulgent countenance of Rama, resembling the spotless Moon and whose eyes resemble red lotuses, is blessed indeed

40005771.author: पदार्थः
40005771.content: या that Sita, सागरान्तायाः bounded by the ocean, पृथिव्याः of the earth, भर्तारम् Rama as lord, अनुगच्छति who is following, महाभागा illustrious lady, जनकात्मजा daughter of Janaka, वैदेही princess of Videha (Sita), कृतकृत्या has accomplished her purpose.

40005771.author: Translation
40005771.content: Sita, the illustrious daughter of Janaka and princess of Videha, has accomplished her purpose by following Rama, the lord of this earth bounded by the ocean.

40005772.author: पदार्थः
40005772.content: काकुत्स्थ: Rama, यस्मिन् on which, कुबेरः Kubera, the lord of wealth, नन्दने इव like in the Nandana garden, वसति staying, असौ such, गिरिराजोपमः comparable to the king of the mountains, Himavan, चित्रकूटः गिरिः Chitrakuta mountain, सुभगः is fortunate.

40005772.author: Translation
40005772.content: Like Kubera in the Nandana garden, Rama lives here on mount Chitrakuta which is indeed blessed like the Himalaya, king of the mountains.

40005773.author: पदार्थः
40005773.content: शस्त्रभृताम् among those who wield weapons, वरः the foremost, महातेजाः most radiant, रामः Rama, यत् that, अध्यास्ते is dwelling, व्यालनिषेवितम् inhabited by wild animals, दुर्गम् inaccessible, इदं वनम् this forest, कृतकार्यम् accomplished its task.

40005773.author: Translation
40005773.content: Fortunate is this inaccessible forest which is inhabited by wild animals to have become the dwelling place of the most radiant Rama, the foremost among the wielders of weapons.

40005774.author: पदार्थः
40005774.content: महातेजा: a man of great radiance, पुरुषर्षभः best of men, महाबाहुः mightyarmed, भरतः Bharata, एवम् in this way, उक्त्वा having said, महत् great, वनम् forest, पद्भ्यामेव on foot alone, प्रविवेश entered.

40005774.author: Translation
40005774.content: Having said thus, the best of men, mightyarmed and highly energetic Bharata entered the great forest on foot.

40005775.author: पदार्थः
40005775.content: वदताम् among the eloquent, वर: best, सः that, गिरिसानुषु on mountain slopes, जातानि growing, पुष्पिताग्राणि tops of trees in bloom, तानि those, द्रुमजालानि मध्येन through the midst of multitude of trees, जगाम went.

40005775.author: Translation
40005775.content: Bharata, the best among the eloquent, made his way amidst multitude of trees grown on mountain slopes with their tops in full bloom.

40005776.author: पदार्थः
40005776.content: सः that, चित्रकूटस्य गिरेः atop Chitrakuta mountain, पुष्पितम् flowering, सालम् sala trees, असाद्य having reached, रामाश्रमगतस्य in Rama's hermitage, अग्नेः of the burning fire, उच्छ्रितं lofty, ध्वजम् banner of smoke, ददर्श beheld.

40005776.author: Translation
40005776.content: Having reached a flowering sala tree atop Chitrakuta mountain, he beheld a lofty banner of smoke rising from the fire burning in Rama's hermitage.

40005777.author: पदार्थः
40005777.content: श्रीमान् the majestic, सह बान्धवः with relatives, भरतः Bharata, तम् that smoke, दृष्ट्वा having seen, रामः Rama, अत्र इति here he is, ज्ञात्वा having known, अम्भसः of waters, पारम् the other bank, गतः इव having reached, मुमोद rejoiced.

40005777.author: Translation
40005777.content: On seeing the smoke, majestic Bharata in the company of relatives concluded that Rama was staying there and rejoiced like a man who had reached the other bank of the river.

40005778.author: पदार्थः
40005778.content: महात्मा the magnanimous one, सः that Bharata, चित्रकूटे गिरौ on Chitrakuta mountain, पुण्यजनोपपन्नम् inhabited by pious men, रामाश्रमम् Rama's hermitage, निशम्य having heard about, चमूम् the army, निवेश्यैव having camped at a distance, पुनः again, गुहेन सार्धम् with Guha, त्वरितः quickly, जगाम went.

40005778.author: Translation
40005778.content: Having heard of Rama's hermitage on the Chitrakuta mountain inhabited by pious men, magnanimous Bharata, commanded his army to stay at a distance, and quickly proceeded with Guha. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे अष्टनवतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the ninetyeighth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
